name: Puebla
tagline: Talavera tiles, mole poblano and the great pyramid
summary: Puebla is a colonial city of tiled facades and over 300 churches, and the birthplace of mole poblano. See the gilded Rosary Chapel, the Talavera pottery workshops, the cathedral and the Palafoxiana library, and visit Cholula, where a church sits on top of the world's largest pyramid by volume with Popocatépetl volcano behind.
seasonNote: Dry season October to April; Chiles en nogada season is August and September.
arrival: About 2 hours by bus from Mexico City.
gettingAround: Walk the centre; taxis or the tourist train to Cholula.
cashTip: Carry pesos for markets, taxis and small places; cards work in larger restaurants. Tip 10 to 15 percent.
foodTip: Mole poblano, chiles en nogada, cemitas and camotes sweets.
